entities.summary: Osama Anwar Okasha was an Egyptian screenwriter and journalist, who wrote weekly for El-Ahram newspaper. He is famous for writing some of the most popular series on Egyptian television, such as Al Helmeya Nights and El Shahd wel Demou, which are popular in Egypt and all across the Middle East.
